parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of Asset Fingerprints for which the automatic collection frequency is configured. Valid values:

- **scheduler\_port_period**: listening port
- **scheduler\_process_period**: running process
- **scheduler\_account_period**: account asset
- **scheduler\_software_period**: software asset
- **scheduler\_cron_period**: scheduled node
- **scheduler\_sca_period**: middleware
- **scheduler\_autorun_period**: startup item
- **scheduler\_lkm_period**: kernel module
- **scheduler\_sca\_proxy_period**: website

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server to query.
>You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
